description: Vítimas de Acidente Trânsito is a dataset listed in State of Minas Gerais open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaria de Estado de Justiça e Segurança Pública – SEJUSP. O Banco de Vítimas de Acidente de Trânsito apresenta informações sobre pessoas envolvidas e identificadas como vítimas em ocorrências de acidentes de trânsito registradas em Minas Gerais. Coverage: Minas Gerais. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaria de Estado de Justiça e Segurança Pública – SEJUSP. It offers 17 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mg-portal.
